# Project Angerona (AngeronaSuite) — llms.txt

> ⚠️ THIS IS THE CANONICAL APP. Angerona is a **PySide6 desktop GUI and shared security core**, package `angerona` under `AngeronaSuite/src/angerona/`. Windows Protect launches through `start-angerona.bat` → `pythonw -m angerona`; macOS Observe is a source/developer preview launched with `python -m angerona`. It is not any separate legacy terminal prototype outside this repository. Read this file first.

## AGENT DIRECTIVES
- CONTEXT FIRST: read this file + `ANGERONA_CAPABILITIES.md` + `ANGERONA_ARCHITECTURE.md` (repo root) before changing anything. The real app = `AngeronaSuite/src/angerona/`.
- Edits = diffs only; never rewrite whole files; no pleasantries. Local-first (no cloud egress without consent); user-mode only (no unsigned drivers); stdlib + PySide6.
- To stop the app: STOP button (`_full_shutdown`) or `kill-all-angerona.bat`. Shutdown unloads resident Angerona llama3 models; kill-all stops only Angerona-owned Python entry points and performs model-specific llama3 unload. It contains no image-wide Python or Ollama runner kill. Closing the window only hides to tray (single-instance guard on loopback :47921).

## STACK / LAUNCH
Python package metadata supports 3.10–3.13; the hardened Windows source bootstrap and launcher require the reviewed **CPython 3.12 x64** ABI and hash-locked wheels. PySide6 GUI · local Ollama (llama3) triage; sanitized cloud fallback is opt-in and default-off. Windows editable install: `pip install -e .[windows,voice]`; Linux/macOS source editions use target extras through the hash-locked installer. Entry `python -m angerona` → `app.py:AngeronaApp` builds core services + `gui/main_window.py:MainWindow`. First-run install, SETUP, `--setup`, and `angerona-setup` enter the same 16-step Full Setup. Self-elevating source launchers overwrite inherited `ANGERONA_DATA` with the sibling `<install-folder>\..\AngeronaData` on D: before elevation; frozen Windows builds prefer protected `D:\AngeronaData`. DB: `flight-recorder.db`. TEMP/TMP, watchdog state, reports, diagnostics, scanner evidence, legacy engine status/telemetry, and incident staging use canonical data/temp helpers rather than the checkout.

## LATEST (v1.12.1 — Cycles 26-30 defensive hardening and SentinelLens)

- **Inventory and UI truth:** 81 Windows-target capabilities; six native
  contracts and 75 compatibility adapters. Built-in implementation labels are
  1.12.1. Typed sortable/clickable assurance rows disclose runtime health,
  coverage, loss, freshness, baseline, dependencies, exact trusted file/digest/
  line evidence, and a red read-only implicated-line highlight.
- **SentinelLens:** app-owned bounded background Syslog, Windows Event, NetFlow,
  JSONL, array, and non-blocking EventBus ingestion with explicit queue/parser/
  analysis loss; deterministic attack-chain graph and anomaly narrative;
  clickable evidence and proposal-only remediation; strict-loopback optional
  local AI with no cloud fallback or public/LAN listening socket.
- **Safe automation:** Guided Auto Adapt performs one audit, closed security-
  intent selection, completeness gate, immutable preview, no-write simulation,
  and separate exact-plan approval. Immutable recovery applies only to the full
  Windows Firewall policy that Host Adaptation can change.
- **Five-loop evidence:** Cycles 26-30 cover source/signer isolation, exhaustive
  module assurance, object/generation identity, authenticated baselines,
  durable delivery and crash recovery, bounded resources, continuity/loss,
  exact response authority, and lifecycle truth. Independent hostile tests are
  retained even when they reopen author-green changes.
- **Honest boundary:** no claim of complete attack coverage, privileged-
  attacker immunity, external certification, fleet parity, or state/agency
  attribution. No live offensive probes or host attacks are part of the gates.
- **Verification:** 2669 passed / 13 intentional
  host-platform skips / 0 failed on the exact v1.12.1 tree. `compileall`, Ruff,
  selfcheck 26/26, workflow-policy, dependency-audit, documentation-drift, and
  diff gates pass. Exact-completion CI run 33294618414 exposed
  enabled-Administrator plus implicit-owner DACL authority and two
  mutable/elevated hosted-runner test couplings; all were remediated. Guarded
  publication verified release commit
  `96b55f7d7a2305216cc68b804c72dc720ce6c88f`, canonical public `main`
  parity, a clean worktree, and all 4/4 README images. This terminal record is
  carried by the required second guarded fast-forward; exact-SHA workflows are
  checked on GitHub.
- Evidence map: `analysis/loop/cycles26-30-summary.md`.

## PRIOR (v1.12.0 — Cycle 25 capability, adaptation, and reliability loop)

- **Inventory truth:** exactly 80 Windows-target capabilities use the validated
  `angerona.capability-contract.v12` schema and a common operational
  lifecycle/freshness/loss snapshot. Five contracts are native and 75 are
  explicit compatibility adapters. Implementation versions are 51 at 1.0.0,
  28 at 1.1.0, and one macOS Observe preview at 0.1.0. Product and module semver
  are independent; do not relabel all modules as native v12.
- **Capability UI:** Capability Center and Module Inspector search, filter,
  typed-sort, and open bounded contract, source, dependency, permission, path,
  lifecycle, loss, freshness, and evidence details. Live projections avoid
  recursive full-contract copying; Inspector event refresh is revision-gated.
- **Guided Auto Adapt:** closed Balanced, Public, and Emergency Lockdown choices
  flow through audit, completeness gating, immutable planning, and no-write
  simulation. Accepted choices are copied immutably before background work. An
  optional apply requires a separate exact-plan confirmation. Context
  automation and legacy `auto_apply` remain proposal-only/false.
- **Recovery truth:** explicit HMAC-authenticated, host-bound, non-replaceable
  enrollment captures complete Windows Firewall policy and is required before
  Host Adaptation mutation. This is not whole-host rollback: hardware,
  services, ports, applications, and network context are observations. Each
  apply also has a pre-change snapshot, HMAC journal, exact verification,
  compensation, startup reconciliation, and circuit breaker.
- **Safe automatic checkup:** one audit plus no-write simulation of every
  profile. Fresh bounded WTS, SSH/current-session, and common third-party
  remote-control agent checks reduce lockout; unknown/error evidence does not
  authorize mutation.
- **Clickable bounded evidence:** typed severity/numeric sorting and bounded
  details cover adaptation, alerts, Live Defense, Context Info, CVE, SOAR,
  capabilities, modules, and governed paths. Alert identity/fingerprint/HMAC
  authenticity are distinct. Alert analysis is 2 active + 6 queued exact event
  IDs; exact-rule suppression is confirmed/15-minute/audited/undoable and not
  allowed for integrity alerts. SOAR clear archives atomically and restore
  refuses overwrite; CVE workers are owned/nonblocking.
- **Durable delivery:** SIEM/Remote use bounded durable outboxes, revision
  cursors, drain-stage-drain, explicit gap receipts, leases/retry/dead-letter,
  persistent tombstones, and HMAC-authenticated mutable state. Queue custody is
  independent of transport-key rotation. Delivery is at least once and can
  duplicate; row deletion/whole-DB rollback is not independently witnessed;
  key coordination uses restart epochs.
- **Atomic state:** core/GUI Settings compensate exact settings bytes, protected
  credentials, environment projection, and autostart. Intel Sync is generation-
  and cancellation-aware with atomic replacement. IPC self-test accounting no
  longer restores stale live counters.
- **Authority hardening:** evolution, mitigation tuning, contextual adaptation,
  and unapproved behavioral learning are proposal-only. Behavioral activation
  requires exact SHA-256 approval. Process/driver/direction-specific firewall
  actions bind exact identity, return codes, postconditions, and rollback;
  ambiguous ACL lockdown is absent from production actions. Self-integrity
  covers full callable semantics; persistence reports COMPLETE/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN.
- **IPC truth:** protected-store key custody includes exact legacy plaintext
  migration/residue removal and fails closed without secure storage. IPC Guard
  is a loopback diagnostic admission preview, not a production payload consumer
  or TPM-backed channel.
- **Standards truth:** ATT&CK 19.2 curated 15-tactic endpoint catalog;
  Navigator 5.3.2/layer 4.5; constrained-preview OCSF 1.8 resolving typed
  observables; deliberately limited Sigma subset with bounded atomic admission/
  refusal receipts. No complete ATT&CK/OCSF/Sigma claim.
- **Upstream comparison:** primary-source review covered Velociraptor monitoring
  and Artifact Exchange warnings, Wazuh stateful/stateless response, Fleet
  policies, osquery packs, and Elastic detection-as-code. Angerona adopted local
  contract/admission/durability lessons, not fleet/server/content parity.
- **Performance:** recorder 22.306 -> 15.925 us/event (28.6%); capability summary
  43.324 -> 1.508 us/call (96.5%); stable Inspector 13.458 -> 0.474 ms (96.5%).
  Batched outbox commits, immutable compiled Sigma plans, and a global per-CVE
  worker cap are proposed only.
- **Authoritative release evidence:** 1,811 passed / 6 expected host-platform
  skips / 0 failed, including all three final-performance tests; those tests
  and their surrounding group also passed a focused 106/106 gate. Compile
  346/346; 82/82 module
  files; 64/64 hooks; 80 discovery; 92 core/module self-tests plus EventBus and
  12 expected inactive/platform skips; selfcheck 26/26 direct/batch; Ruff and
  diff clean.
- Full three-round disposition, sources, and residuals:
  `analysis/loop/cycle25/summary.md`.

## LATEST (v1.10.3 — Cycle 23 SSH, audit continuity, and zero-trust paths)
- **Actor-neutral threat model:** translate documented advanced/state-grade
  tradecraft into observable SSH, tunneling, log-clear/continuity, route,
  DNS/DHCP, and telemetry-suppression patterns. Never use this evidence as an
  agency or state attribution engine.
- **SSH guard (`SSHG`):** `core/ssh_surface.py` and
  `modules/ssh_surface_guard.py` perform bounded read-only OpenSSH Include,
  configured key/CA/principals, public-key fingerprint, full replacement-
  custody, service/process/listener/socket, fixed Windows OpenSSH event, and
  normalized tunnel/forwarding observation. It collects no private keys or
  credentials, does not retain or publish full command lines or raw endpoints,
  and performs no probe or login attempt.
- **Audit guard (`ALIG`):** `core/windows_event_log.py`,
  `core/event_log_integrity.py`, and `modules/audit_log_guard.py` bind fixed
  Windows channel/provider/event triples, bounded oldest-retained replay,
  staged generation anchors, clear/refill race rejection, gap/record-reuse
  detection, and authenticated paired cursor/enrollment state. It observes only
  and never clears or restores a log.
- **Network guard (`NZTR`):** `core/network_trust.py` and
  `modules/network_trust_monitor.py` treat every physical Wi-Fi/Ethernet path as
  untrusted, retain only purpose-tokenized DNS/DHCP/route/gateway/profile/epoch
  identities, authenticate restart baselines, fail closed on incomplete or
  overflowed IPv4/IPv6 evidence, and persist a new path as provisional until it
  remains active and unchanged.
- **Personal Sentinel client:** `core/personal_sentinel_gateway.py` enrolls one
  exact interface/private HTTPS default gateway from
  `<AngeronaData>/config/personal_sentinel_gateway.json`. It requires normal
  TLS/hostname validation plus a leaf pin, policy digest, nonce/freshness,
  no-proxy/no-redirect, peer match, bounded schemas, optional mTLS, and unchanged
  pre/post selected-route context. It is a client only—no gateway appliance,
  server, routing role, router management/discovery/credential, or firmware
  attestation is shipped.
- **Topology and trust:** `Angerona host -> operator-controlled Personal
  Sentinel gateway/firewall -> upstream/ISP router -> Internet`. A successful
  response attests only that exact path. It never grants endpoint, identity,
  application, destination, upstream-router, or firmware trust.
- **Independent freshness boundary:** `core/independent_high_water.py` defines a
  strict injected monotonic CAS protocol for audit/network state. A conforming
  separately administered server or policy-bound TPM authority is not bundled.
  Default state is `local-authenticity-only` and
  `independent_freshness_verified=false`. The compact Personal Sentinel receipt,
  another local HMAC file, and in-memory test fixtures are not independent
  anti-rollback custody.
- **Live Defense Activity:** `gui/live_defense_activity.py` reads only public
  EventBus fields/coarse module states, requests at most 16 events, and displays
  at most five sanitized rows through the existing dashboard cadence. It is not
  live code, a debugger, raw telemetry, hidden reasoning, or chain-of-thought.
- **ARIA Defense Memory:** `assets/angerona_defense_memory.json` is loaded by
  `core/defense_memory.py` only after root confinement, stable bounded non-
  reparse admission, strict schema/duplicate rejection, and canonical SHA-256
  pin verification. It enters local RAG as
  `angerona://defense-memory` for capability, usage, defense, and actor-neutral
  tradecraft questions. It is data-only; only selected, bounded, redacted
  excerpts are eligible for an already authorized cloud fallback.
- **Three-round closure:** R1 fixed 9/9; R2 fixed 5/6 and left the external
  independent authority deferred while delivering its client/store contract;
  R3 fixed 1/1. Round 2 QA also added the SSH guard's optional compatibility
  `register()` export. Older A-04/A-06/R6-03 residuals remain unchanged; A-07 is
  resolved because Shadow Shield uses SHA-256.
- **Performance:** unchanged audit checkpoint work 42.189 ms → 1.001 ms (97.6%);
  measured SSH process enumeration 41.050 ms → 3.726 ms (90.9%); maximum-bound
  clean network snapshot 1,319.25 us → 88.70 us (93.3%); maximum-size SSH user-
  token expansion 213.317 ms → 1.335 ms (99.4%). Round 3 applied no optimization
  after candidates were immaterial or slower. No cadence, freshness, anchor,
  completeness, route, or privacy gate was reduced.
- **Final evidence:** pytest **1,460 passed / 5 expected host-capability skips /
  0 failed** from 1,465 cases across 208 files; compile **321/321**; module-file
  import **73/73**; discovery **71/71**; zero-argument compatibility hooks
  **58/58**; standalone core/Shark self-tests **22/22**; module harness **50 pass
  / 0 fail / 21 expected skips** plus EventBus PASS; direct and batch selfcheck
  **26/26**; Ruff clean.
- Full disposition, primary-source URLs, tests, limits, and backlog:
  `analysis/loop/cycle23/summary.md`.

## LATEST (v1.10.3 — App Control evidence and exhaustive UI/function closure)
- `modules/app_control_monitor.py` reads the Windows Code Integrity Operational channel through modern WEVT. It distinguishes audit-would-block and enforced-block decisions, strictly joins bounded 3089 signature rows by ActivityID, preserves policy events, and never changes App Control policy or grants response authority.
- Cursor and pending ActivityID state use purpose-separated HMACs and atomic writes. The cursor also binds an exact record digest. Retention loss, clear/regression, record-ID reuse, pre-poll replacement, staged-query replacement, and checkpoint-write replacement become explicit gap evidence with reset/replay; exact local paths are omitted from ordinary EventBus/UI/export details.
- UI closure covers 46 construction paths, 46 tab sites, 244 buttons, 9 actions, 3 menus, and 32 contextual Info topics. All 10 functional Settings tabs open their exact isolated source sandbox. Info/sandbox and Red Team editor paths fail soft, the ATT&CK heatmap fits 800x600, close-order timers are owned, and all visible **Adaptation** spelling is corrected.
- Selfcheck no longer waives a hung module merely because output contains “timed out” or an unknown `status=stopped`; skips use structured callbacks and an explicit stopped-module allowlist.
- Verification: pytest **1,305 passed / 3 intentional platform skips / 0 failed** from 1,308 collected; compile **310/310**; static discovery **68 modules / 0 errors**; module self-tests **48 pass / 0 genuine failures / 21 classified skips**; selfcheck **26/26**; full Ruff passes. Physical clear/rollover/restart/suspend WEVT soak remains an external acceptance gate.

## LATEST (v1.10.1 — Host Adaptation improvement loop)
- The top-left **ADAPTATION** button opens a seven-tab, menu-complete local workbench with an always-visible **ADAPT HOST** action and dedicated Adapt Host tab; the dashboard reserves a centered activity lane so startup progress cannot be clipped by header actions.
- The core captures privacy-minimized hardware, services, listeners, network context, effective Windows Firewall ActiveStore profiles, and a bounded rule inventory with explicit completeness/truncation/error metadata. Golden baselines, exact finding fingerprints, and JSON/CSV export are local and integrity-wrapped.
- Closed, typed firewall profiles use short-lived host/precondition-bound previews. Apply requires exact approval, a verified firewall export, trusted tools, effective-state postconditions, and automatic verified recovery; rollback verifies both its artifacts and restored state.
- SSID/VPN/Public triggers default to proposal-only. Separately armed auto-apply is revision-bound and single-flight; strongest posture wins, automatic relaxation is refused, and a persistent circuit breaker limits repeated changes.
- Final evidence: focused **20 passed**; pytest **1078 passed / 3 intentional platform skips / 0 failed**; selfcheck **26/26**. Deep firewall filter joins, executable signer/hash attestation, real elevated connectivity acceptance, and the longer-term visionary designs remain explicit backlog/gates.

## LATEST (v1.10.0 — Cycle 22 unattended defense, proof-bound remediation, and release hardening)
- `core/selftest.py` uses a bounded module worker pool and classifies non-native, operator-disabled, and Chill-paused capabilities as explicit skips during an all-module run. An explicitly requested native-module diagnostic still runs. Only inherited lifecycle readiness failures (or audited opt-ins) are restartable; dependency/provisioning failures and timeouts remain manual. Repair runs off the GUI thread without rewriting configuration. `modules/ai_triage.py` checks readiness through non-inference `/api/tags`, preserves deployment model overrides, and never probes or wakes Ollama in Chill.
- `core/chill_mode.py` defines the network-first policy; `core/chill_runtime.py` supplies the GUI-neutral EventBus-revision controller used by desktop and headless paths. Chill keeps network/C2/WFP/ETW-Sysmon/AV/SOAR/USB/resilience sentinels available, parks deep scanners, runs sparse maintenance sequentially, and wakes on authenticated active-threat evidence. `ollama_lifecycle.py` applies zero keep-alive/unload while idle. Live profiling identified presentation—not sensor polling—as the dominant idle CPU source: dashboard presentation is 5 s in active Chill, 10 s inactive, and 15 s hidden with elapsed-time-equivalent panel periods; High/Critical evidence gets one coalesced immediate GUI wake. ARIA animations stop in Chill/inactive/hidden, and minimized watchdog/scanner UI uses a 10 s cadence with unchanged-list caching. Sensor/supervisor recovery cadence remains unchanged.
- `core/threat.py` separates severity from disposition. Exact `practice_scope.py` provenance identifies drill artifacts/processes without filename heuristics. Practice, exposure, health, Defender-state, USB-insertion, and vulnerability findings stay visible but cannot drive global Critical; only active-threat/active-attack evidence can drive High/Critical. `posture.py`, Resolve Center, and Daily Briefing consume this rule.
- EventBus has a separate bounded HMAC-authenticated High/Critical priority lane so normal-queue pressure cannot erase action-relevant evidence; overflow only schedules verification and is never response authority. Live Alerts queues directly. SOAR reads a bounded JSONL tail plus state overlay, exposes approve/dismiss/execute, and verifies exact digest/HMAC before action and after confirmation.
- Scan Center uses adaptive controls, cancellable worker/child cleanup, and Defender activity/liveness instead of invented progress. Custom Defender scans remain no-remediation. Selected removable-media scans require live authorization and canonical-target recheck. `usb_policy.py` binds a protected PIN to volume GUID/serial/filesystem identity; enrollment, lockout, Settings reset/revocation, and same-letter device swap are explicit.
- Source-launch persistence, reports, diagnostics, scanner evidence, sidecars, and temp work stay under canonical D:-drive helpers. `storage_hygiene.py` rejects reparse/junction roots, overlap, and special files. Deception defaults to `data_dir()/deception/static` and `/smart`; personal-folder canaries/sampling require explicit `deception_user_folders` opt-in in Settings or Full Setup.
- Qt teardown guards in Scan Center and dashboard/threat/module/alert panels block late signals and defer deletion until work ends. Resilience heartbeat v2 is a fixed 32-byte per-component derived-key HMAC record with freshness/replay validation; FRZ now produces that record instead of its legacy 16-byte raw mmap. Invalid, replayed, or legacy heartbeat/recovery state cannot authorize process open/signal; spawn-lock I/O uncertainty fails closed and retries under budgets/safe mode.
- JARVIS authority is read only from SecureStore; inherited token variables are scrubbed before elevation/runtime, and Full Setup provides masked enrollment and regeneration. FRZ v2 builds/searches only as `frz/frz_watchdog_v2.exe`, with pinned `go.mod`/`go.sum` and no mutable `go get`. Go was unavailable on this host, so the native FRZ build is an external gate.
- `practice_verification.py` makes red-team closure report-bound and independent: an exact candidate is applied, then inert positive/negative controls invoke the production Purple Guard detector and require authenticated EventBus detection, persisted SQLite evidence, real Active Response SOAR with response HMAC/persistence, cleanup, and a signed receipt. A distinct later run/exact action contract is mandatory; expiry/future miss reopens. Never claim every drill automatically reaches 100%.
- `case_management.py` adds typed normalized bounded observables, suggested/approved/rejected review states, idempotency, TTL/purge/migration, and bounded related-case results. Only approved/non-excluded records enter a derived-key HMAC private index. Record-integrity failures are refused. Sanitized exports contain aggregate counts only and correlation has no posture/response authority.
- Windows launch refuses an existing CPython 3.14 virtual environment. `Repair-Angerona-Python.bat/.ps1` requires typed confirmation, reparse-safe fixed root, old-environment preservation, Authenticode-verified Python Software Foundation CPython 3.12 x64 through trusted winget when needed, locked wheels, and rollback. Bootstrap installs reviewed pip 26.2.1 first through SHA-256 `71138adf1f4ca900cdb7d289c21b7494329f2332b6d85f0e1c42108c0384ed3e` and refuses a version mismatch before dependencies. Task validation recognizes Windows' omitted `RunLevel` as the serialized Limited default only for the expected `InteractiveToken` principal. The push helper aborts on add/commit failure and uses an environment-backed UTF-8 message file with `git commit -F`; manual release branch names become deterministic path-safe artifacts without altering tags.
- `backup_to_F.bat` validates the fixed F: destination and repository root, rejects reparses/junctions/path escapes, excludes secret/runtime/cache/model/build state, and performs stale-private-state cleanup before and after mirroring. `--validate-only` is non-destructive; Robocopy 0–7 stays successful. No real mirror ran during verification.
- Verification: pytest **1038 passed / 3 intentional platform skips / 0 failed**; package compile **297/297**; core import **125/125**; **66 modules / 0 discovery errors / 0 duplicate codes**; core self-tests **18/18**; module self-tests **51 pass / 16 expected skips / 0 unexpected failures**; selfcheck **26/26**; Ruff, Bandit Medium/High, `pip-audit`, launcher bootstrap, PowerShell parsing, privacy, and repeated async-Qt lifecycle gates pass.
- Host repair and boundaries: the Python repair completed on this host and protected autostart was live-reconciled to CPython 3.12 `pythonw -m angerona --chill`. Fresh-logon and clean-machine registration, physical sleep/resume and long elevated soaks, clean-machine installer validation, signing/notarization/publisher custody, native privileged sensors, production Defender/ETW/AMSI/WFP evidence, HA/DR, mTLS/OIDC, and independent assessment remain external gates. This is not an enterprise-parity claim.

## LATEST (v1.10.0 — capability parity and defensive interoperability)
- `core/security_interop.py` owns the canonical twelve-domain comparison and
  defensive-import boundary. Levels are operational, integrated, preview,
  foundation, or external-gate; the schema refuses an unqualified parity claim.
- Selected local Suricata EVE, Zeek JSON, OCSF JSON, and generic defensive
  JSON/JSONL normalize into `EvidenceStore`. Reject UNC/network paths,
  links/reparse points, files over 32 MiB, lines over 256 KiB, more than 5,000
  scanned lines, or more than 1,000 retained records. Only reviewed fields cross
  normalization; copied prose is redacted. Audit stores source SHA-256/counts,
  never the source path or raw event.
- Optional osquery uses only known system install locations and internal fixed
  SELECT templates. It accepts no executable path, SQL, command, extension,
  remote target, or automatic install. Shell is false; platform, environment,
  timeout, rows, columns and output bytes are bounded.
- Full PCAP, production mTLS/OIDC, HA search, true multi-tenancy, hardware-backed
  keys, publisher custody, independent DR/penetration evidence and long physical-
  host soaks remain explicit external gates. Never collapse these into a score.
- Verification: pytest **848 passed / 3 intentional platform skips / 0 failed**;
  focused parity/interop/Local SOC **9/9**; full Ruff and compile, changed-surface
  Bandit medium/high, and diff/whitespace gates pass.

## ARCHITECTURE MAP (`src/angerona/`)
- `app.py` — wires Config, EventBus, FlightRecorder(storage), ModuleManager, StatusReporter, MainWindow. Subscribes `storage.record_bus`, `incidents.on_event`, `init_log(db_path)`, and `init_tracker().on_event` at startup.
- `core/` — `module_base.py` (BaseModule), `module_manager.py` (auto-discovers modules and enforces explicit platform availability), `platforms.py` (canonical Windows/macOS/Linux capability contract and import-safe AST preflight), `sensor_events.py` (bounded versioned platform-neutral event envelope), `eventbus.py` (complete event HMAC + bounded recent history without subscriber suppression), `telemetry_contracts.py` (TECT bounded deadline/echo state machine), `windows_event_log.py` + `event_log_integrity.py` (fixed-source bounded Windows audit continuity), `ssh_surface.py` (bounded SSH posture/key/runtime evidence), `network_trust.py` + `personal_sentinel_gateway.py` (tokenized physical-path state and pinned gateway client), `independent_high_water.py` (injected external freshness protocol only), `defense_memory.py` (pinned data-only ARIA reference), `config.py`, `storage.py` (durable WAL recorder plus committed revision and immediate-only GUI reads), `security_interop.py` (honest comparator matrix, bounded NDR/OCSF import and fixed osquery snapshots), `singleton.py` (:47921), `commands.py` (console), `selftest.py`, `autostart.py`, `privilege.py`, `status_report.py`, `remediation_log.py` (SQLite audit ledger, `init_log()`/`get_log()`), `attack_tracker.py` (live ATT&CK 19.2 heat; 107 curated techniques, 15 tactics; `init_tracker()`/`get_tracker()`; `on_event()` bus subscriber; `snapshot()`), `process_allowlist.py` (exact-path enforcement for path-rich events; basename fallback only for genuinely pathless telemetry), `drill_resolution.py` (authenticated typed action contracts plus applied/verified/expired/reopened drill lifecycle and signed receipts), `assistant.py` (immutable, expiring ARIA action staging), and `action_policy.py` (non-authoritative Response Safety Kernel shadow evaluator). **Next-gen engines (v1.7.6, additive/read-only/unwired):** `cortex.py` (unified entity-graph correlation brain — per-entity malice via convergence fusion; `init_cortex()/get_cortex()/attach(bus)/snapshot()`), `angerona_score.py` (one 0–100 score + next-best-action), `sigma_engine.py` (Sigma-subset matcher), `ocsf_export.py` (OCSF Detection Finding), `d3fend_map.py` (ATT&CK→D3FEND), `purple_loop.py` (coverage-gap → review-gated proposals), `copilot.py` (local NL query over Cortex/events).
- `gui/` — `main_window.py` (vector-icon header actions including LOCAL SOC; DashboardCards; Modules|Alerts/SOAR/Scan Center over ARIA/Console/System Pulse; StatusStrip; two-tier refresh), `operations_center.py` (toggleable Flow Dashboard with hover-expanded radial metrics and Overview/Cases/Hunt/Assets/Detection Content/Parity & Interop/Audit tabs; slow hunts/inventory/imports stay off the Qt thread), `pages.py` (StatCard, dashboard panels, alert/case-facing dialogs, Settings), `header_controls.py` (accessible icons plus forward/reverse real-window reveal), `flow_window.py` (six-stage World View architecture flow), and `attack_heatmap.py` (tabbed ATT&CK coverage and hit matrix).
- `modules/` — **71 declared** `BaseModule` subclasses, AUTO-DISCOVERED by `module_manager` (scans `angerona.modules`, no manual registration). Platform gating exposes only compatible capabilities and imports only explicitly compatible modules on non-Windows hosts. The set now also includes **audit_log_guard**, **ssh_surface_guard**, **network_trust_monitor**, **app_control_monitor** (authenticated, read-only Code Integrity decision/signature evidence), **linux_observe**, **kernel_posture_ledger** (bounded, authenticated, read-only kernel-boundary posture evidence), **macos_observe**, **purple_guard**, **evidence_lattice (ELAT)**, and the established detection, response, telemetry, resilience, and platform modules.
  **G2 sensor modules (new):** **sysmon_listener (SYSL)** — Sysmon XML + win32evtlog bridge (EID 1/3/6/8/10/25); **mem_inject_scanner (MINJ)** — VirtualQueryEx RWX scanner (T1055), JIT allowlist, 60s dedup; **ransomware_heuristics (RANS)** — Shannon entropy ≥7.9 + mass-rename detector, user-folder watchdog; **wfp_controller (WFPC)** — iphlpapi GetExtendedTcpTable/UdpTable singleton, IPv4+IPv6 (BL-17 fixed), 5s TTL cache; **amsi_bridge (AMSI)** — AmsiScanBuffer consumer (NOT patching), EICAR health check; **wlan_monitor (WLAN)** — evil-twin detection via netsh SSID/BSSID diff; **arp_watchdog (ARPW)** — ARP cache diff + optional scapy sniffer; **av_telemetry_bridge (AVTB)** — Defender Operational log (EID 1116/1117/5001) + Get-MpThreatDetection PS fallback; **dynamic_resource (DRES)** — HIGH_PRIORITY_CLASS escalation under load, NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS cooldown after 60s.
  **G3 hardening modules (new):** **kernel_bridge (KRNL)** — PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx ring buffer via DeviceIoControl to AngeronaSensor.sys (kernel/AngeronaSensor/); **fast_path (FPTH)** — 17-rule deterministic IOC library (Mimikatz/PSExec/shadow-copy/AMSI-bypass etc.) that emits CRITICAL immediately bypassing Ollama triage. NOTE: `AngeronaSuite\modules\` (top-level) is only a README — real modules live in `src/angerona/modules/`.
- `engines/` — core_engine, defense_monitor, edr_logger, sniffer, monitor, watchdog, cloud_fallback, reporter, persistence, rag, unified_edr, self_compiler, ai_telemetry, **mcp_server** (`AngeronaMCPServer` — HTTP+SSE MCP 2024-11-05 server on loopback :47923; 6 read-only tools: `get_recent_alerts`, `get_module_status`, `get_attack_heatmap`, `get_incidents`, `get_remediation_log`, `search_events`; opt-in via `config.mcp_enabled`; started in `app.py:start()` after modules load; stopped in `shutdown()`; no data egress).
- `shark/` — `shark_attack.py` (SharkAttackEngine adversary sim), `aar_report.py` (after-action report).
- `telemetry/` — `sensors.py`, **`worldview.py`** (WorldViewEngine).
- `platforms/macos/` — `observe.py` (privacy-minimized psutil process/flow baselining), `keychain.py` (Security.framework generic-password storage with no CLI secret exposure), and `native_bridge.py` (bounded HMAC/freshness/nonce/schema verification for a signed native host). `native/macos/` contains Xcode source scaffolding for `SMAppService`/System Extension lifecycle, FSEvents file observation with rescan/overflow flag preservation, and an observe-only Endpoint Security client; no signed native binary or entitlement is shipped.
- `academy/` — Flight Instructor Mode (AI coaching narration), achievements, profiler.

## MODULE CONTRACT (drop-in)
Subclass `core.module_base.BaseModule`; set `name/description/category/version/enabled_by_default`; declare a literal module-level `SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS = ("windows", ...)`, copy it to the class as `supported_platforms`, and set `capability_mode` to `observe`, `detect`, `protect`, or `respond`. Missing/malformed declarations fail closed as Windows-only. Implement `run()` (daemon loop, poll `self.stopping`, use `self.sleep()`); call `self.emit(msg, Severity.X, **details)` and `self.set_health(pct, note)`; override `self_test()->(bool,str)`. ModuleManager threads/lifecycle it only when available; health_state maps to ok/degraded/critical/failed/off colours.

## NEW / RECENT FEATURES

## LATEST (v1.10.0 addendum — Flow Dashboard and Local SOC)
- **Toggle:** `Config.dashboard_mode` accepts only `classic` or `flow`. Settings
  General/Appearance and Full Setup expose the startup choice; invalid persisted
  input fails safely to Classic. The LOCAL SOC header icon always opens Flow and
  Flow retains a one-click Classic return.
- **UI:** `gui/operations_center.py` owns five hover-expanded radial infographics
  (case flow, evidence, audit trust, asset map, detections), low-frequency flowing
  connectors, and Overview, Cases, Hunt, Assets, Detection Content, and Audit tabs.
  Clicking a ring routes to the related tab. Motion honors Angerona/OS reduced
  motion and stops when the dialog closes.
- **Cases/hunts:** `core/operations_center.py` composes the existing local
  `CaseStore`, bounded typed `EvidenceStore.hunt`, evidence custody, and sanitized
  export. Case evidence counts use one aggregate SQL query. Attaching a result
  stores digest/size/provenance/privacy metadata only, not the raw evidence body.
- **Assets:** collection is explicit and privacy-minimized: OS family/release/
  architecture, Angerona version/module counts, and Python distribution names/
  versions. Do not add hostname, username, home paths, command lines, or network
  identity to this snapshot.
- **Detection/audit:** packages are immutable, staged/quarantined, and require a
  currently trusted Ed25519 publisher signature before activation. Case, hunt,
  evidence, inventory, detection, and export actions enter an append-only chained-
  HMAC admin ledger. Case custody and audit keys are domain-derived from a 256-bit
  master held in the OS-protected credential store.
- **Authority boundary:** Local SOC requires no cloud, accepts no SQL/script or
  generic remote shell, executes no model output, cannot activate unsigned
  detections, and copies no raw evidence into the case database. It is a local
  workflow-integration layer, not production multi-tenant SSO/HA/PCAP infrastructure.
- **Verification:** authoritative pytest **844 passed / 3 intentional platform
  skips / 0 failed**; focused Local SOC/UI/data regression **58/58**; complete
  Ruff and Python bytecode compilation pass; changed-surface Bandit medium/high
  reports zero findings; the 107-page master manual render passed visual review.

## LATEST (v1.10.0 addendum — Device Security Lab and Scan Center)
- **Device Security Lab:** the Red Team tab provides owner-authorized, local passive posture checks for USB, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and display/HDMI surfaces. File-based companion enrollment requires short-lived Ed25519 proof-of-possession; the controller stores only the public key/fingerprint. Evidence is signed, fresh, replay-protected, and redacted. There is no target address, listener, scan, exploit, packet, credential, or response surface. Pinned mTLS companion transport remains a future gate.
- **Scan Center:** Live Alerts opens a dedicated tab for bounded YARA-X/metadata path scanning with symlink, reparse-point, UNC, and remote-mount safety; passive local-listener audit; privacy-safe aggregate network posture; trusted `MpCmdRun` Defender orchestration; cancellation, progress, and export. Custom Defender scans disable remediation; quick/full scans may apply only configured Windows Security actions.
- **Product boundary:** Angerona complements Microsoft Defender; it does not replace Defender's kernel, AMSI, cloud, or reputation stack.
- **Updated evidence:** pytest **839 passed / 3 intentional platform skips / 0 failed**; discovery **66 modules / 0 errors**; headless selfcheck **26/26**. Compileall, Ruff, source-trust, workflow-policy, and diff/whitespace gates pass.

## LATEST (v1.10.0 — Cycle 19 setup, supply, and runtime hardening)
- **Unified Full Setup:** installer first-run, the GUI SETUP button, `--setup`, and `angerona-setup` invoke one 16-step, resumable configuration program. It uses OS-protected storage for integration secrets and the cross-platform Signal PIN; no setup step grants response authority by itself.
- **Windows trust boundary:** the canonical batch launchers establish trusted Windows/System32 tooling before UAC, rebuild a minimal environment, scrub inherited code-loading/proxy/provider/fleet/resilience values, and keep `--setup` across the sanitized relaunch. Sidecars, Black Box, and the operator shell receive secret-free allowlisted environments. R4-04 child propagation is closed; protected values still published for legacy in-process consumers require a future just-in-time credential broker before the broad architectural debt is closed.
- **POSIX supply closure:** Linux x86-64 and macOS arm64 CPython 3.12 installers/releases each bind the complete 75-wheel closure by exact filename, size, and SHA-256 before an offline `--require-hashes --no-deps` install. Intel macOS is explicitly refused until a safe current wheel exists; no vulnerable downgrade or unreviewed sdist fallback is enabled. `cryptography==50.0.0` has 0 known advisories in the requirements audit.
- **Authenticated bounded recorder:** `AsyncFlightRecorder` uses bounded memory lanes plus an authenticated segmented disk spool (2 MiB segments, 32 segments, 64 MiB pending cap), batch replay receipts, raw quarantine, visible backpressure, and bounded shutdown. The 40,000-event benchmark improved 33.855 s → 2.080 s (**16.3x**) with 40,000/40,000 authoritative events preserved. A full-cap replay deadlock found in the final gate is fixed.
- **Final authority checks:** SOAR verifies Event HMAC again at action time; shutdown tokens enforce future-skew and bounded replay state; Signal commands require the exact normalized sender identity. The software-HMAC Visibility Attestation MVP reports `healthy` / `degraded` / `blind` / `untrusted`, excludes raw telemetry/paths/users/response fields, and has no response authority. It is explicitly not native, hardware-backed, or a completeness proof against a compromised signer.
- **Final evidence:** pytest **839 passed / 3 intentional platform skips / 0 failed**; discovery **66 modules / 0 errors**; headless selfcheck **26/26**. Ruff, compileall, source-trust, workflow-YAML, workflow-policy, diff/whitespace, requirements `pip-audit` (**0 known vulnerabilities**), and full-source Bandit medium/high (**0 findings; warnings only**) pass. The focused final group passed **84/84**, followed by the performance/settings group **18/18**.
- **Security/privacy:** the final red-team result is **0 Critical / 0 High / 1 Medium**, with the one Medium POSIX supply finding fixed. The public working tree secret scan is clean. Historical Git author email remains operator-owned privacy debt; removing it requires an explicit history rewrite and was not performed.
- **External limits:** native Linux/macOS frozen execution on their release runners, clean-machine install/upgrade/uninstall, publisher signing/notarization, physical sleep/resume, long elevated live-sensor/Ollama soak, independent assessment, production mTLS/OIDC/HA, hardware-backed visibility proof, and an in-process credential broker remain outside this local gate.
- **Proposed, not shipped:** Detection Contract v3 (ATT&CK v19.2/Sigma 2.1), privacy-minimized baselines, OCSF/ECS evidence mappings, TUF plus Sigstore client verification, native least-privilege sensors, causal counterfactuals, OS-owned supervision, capability-limited WASM extensions, and short-lived fleet policy rings remain in `analysis/loop/cycle19/innovation.md`. Only the bounded software-HMAC visibility MVP shipped.

## LATEST (v1.9.4 — Cycle 17 adversarial convergence)
- **Native crash and shutdown closure:** `AnalysisWorker` sends payloads through `result_ready` and leaves native `QThread.finished()` exclusively responsible for cleanup. The formerly crashing lifecycle passed 30/30 fresh-process repetitions with no post-fix dump. Fleet loopback shutdown now cooperatively interrupts partial requests, atomically rejects setup races, drains handlers, and releases the replay ledger.
- **Truthful remediation:** model-authored CVE PowerShell remains inert staged review text. `staged`, `executed`, and `verified` are separate states. AI outage/no-fix outcomes cannot bulk-suppress CISA KEVs; only an expiring, evidenced, approved `not_applicable` record leaves scoring. Sandbox tests run in disposable deadline-bounded children without pausing production sensors.
- **Remote authority boundary:** authenticated Remote Bridge telemetry is receiver-owned and `remote-observe-only`. Remote numeric PIDs/paths cannot become local response targets, peer module names cannot become local corroboration, and SOAR plus Evolution Engine reject this evidence before process, file, firewall, or generated-rule mutation.
- **Long-session performance:** Purple Guard's unchanged-policy path measured 2.26x faster and avoids up to 86,399 redundant opens/parses per active day. Revision-gated expanded Console refresh measured 1,495x faster over 500 unchanged 804-KiB ticks. System Pulse, module-resource, and Top Talkers details skip unchanged history/graph/table work without reducing sampling or detection cadence.
- **Release and dependency assurance:** packaged wheels and elevated CPython 3.12 x64 source bootstrap use one SHA-256 hash lock with no unhashed fallback. The exact Inno Setup 6.7.1 artifact is digest-verified, Setup rejects downgrade below its HKLM64 high-water mark, and `cryptography` 50.0.0 closes GHSA-g6cj-pr64-35w5 / PYSEC-2026-3552. The post-update dependency audit reported no known vulnerabilities in the audited environment.
- **Final evidence:** pytest **744 passed / 2 intentional platform skips / 0 failed**; source compilation **279/279**; `tools/selfcheck.py` **26/26**; discovery **65 modules / 0 errors**; full-source Bandit medium/high **0 findings**. No crash dump or Windows crash/hang event appeared after the final validation start.
- **External acceptance limits:** physical sleep/resume, an 8–24 hour interactive live-sensor/Ollama soak, clean-VM install/upgrade/downgrade/uninstall and attestation checks, publisher signing, independent review, and production fleet identity/high availability remain external gates. The sandbox child inherits the operator token and is not an AppContainer boundary.
- **Proposed, not shipped:** Crash Breadcrumb Capsule/circuit breaker, RMM trust ledger, read-only WinRE/QMR readiness, Windows Hello-bound response approval, MCP tool/data provenance firewall, purpose/epoch telemetry tokens, and browser session-theft correlation remain research proposals in `analysis/loop/innovation_ideas.md`.

## LATEST (2026-07-29 — Cycle 6 enterprise trust, telemetry integrity, and bounded response)
- **Connector authentication closure:** the Teams development bypass is process-local and direct-loopback-only. Forwarding headers, tunnels, non-local peers, and persisted settings cannot activate it; those requests still require a valid JWT.
- **Protected authority custody:** EventBus and shutdown commands use separate keys. Elevated startup establishes the protected runtime parent before key access, quarantines unsafe pre-existing authorities, and fails closed on malformed or unreadable material. This is a user-mode ACL boundary, not protection from an already-compromised Administrator/SYSTEM principal.
- **Authenticated GUI telemetry:** the indexed GUI SQLite cursor verifies each persisted Event HMAC before display. Missing, forged, malformed, or tampered rows become a canonical Critical ledger-integrity alert; bounded 200-row catch-up and duplicate-free cursor reads remain intact.
- **Kernel-boundary posture ledger:** `kernel_posture_ledger` records bounded, HMAC-authenticated user-mode observations of Code Integrity, HVCI/VBS, vulnerable-driver controls, driver-service state, and evidence-source health. It is read-only and does not claim kernel enforcement. The custom driver remains lab-only behind separate assurance gates.
- **Transactional network-containment boundary:** `wfp_controller` constructs deterministic, typed, expiry-bound plans with mandatory loopback/DNS/DHCP recovery exclusions, exact-plan approval, rollback receipts, apply-time reconstruction, and optional independent verification. Preview is the default. There is no silent firewall enforcement; actual mutation requires a separate auditable privileged broker.
- **Live coverage accounting:** bounded per-sensor state exposes sequence gaps, duplicates, regressions, missing metadata, staleness, and eviction. Process-local state and legacy unsequenced events do not imply complete coverage.
- **Performance/UI:** Resolve Center renders 25 rows per page and skips unchanged rebuilds. The persistent telemetry cursor retained its measured **14.9x / 93.3%** idle-poll improvement; no protection cadence was reduced.
- **Honest deployment boundary:** elevated source launch rejects redirected, incomplete, or non-fixed roots and repeats containment preflight, but an editable user-owned checkout remains weaker than the signed Administrator-owned packaged install. Angerona remains user-mode, is not tamper-proof or enterprise-certified, and ships no production kernel driver.
- **Recorded Cycle 6 gate:** repository pytest **223 passed / 2 intentional platform skips / 0 failed**; package compile **233/233**; discovery **65 modules / 0 errors**; headless self-check **26/26**. Evidence is recorded in `analysis/loop/cycle6/final_verification.md`.

## LATEST (2026-07-28 — macOS Observe architecture foundation)
- **Honest platform contracts:** `core/platforms.py` canonicalizes Windows/macOS/Linux, treats legacy bundled modules as Windows-only, AST-preflights non-Windows module files before import, and exposes availability, supported platforms, requirements, and capability mode through `ModuleManager.capability_inventory()`. Unsupported modules never start and cannot inflate posture.
- **Normalized cross-platform telemetry:** `core/sensor_events.py` defines schema v1 for bounded process/file/network/authentication/system/security observations. Platform sensors publish this envelope inside the authenticated EventBus event instead of leaking OS-specific payload assumptions through the core.
- **macOS Observe sensor:** `modules/macos_observe.py` + `platforms/macos/observe.py` baseline processes and established flows, then report new activity at a bounded cadence. Command lines and usernames are excluded by default; the module explicitly reports 75%/observe-only health until an entitled native sensor exists.
- **Native trust boundary:** `platforms/macos/native_bridge.py` accepts only size-bounded macOS frames with a valid HMAC, fresh timestamp, unique nonce, exact frame fields, and valid normalized event. `native/macos/` supplies source scaffolding for a signed host, `SMAppService` lifecycle, FSEvents file observation that preserves rescan/overflow flags, system-extension activation, and NOTIFY-only Endpoint Security subscriptions. It is not a packaged binary and has no AUTH/blocking subscription.
- **OS credential storage:** `core/secure_store.py` retains current-user DPAPI on Windows and uses Security.framework Keychain generic-password storage on macOS. Secret values are never placed in command-line arguments or plaintext compatibility files; unsupported platforms continue to fail closed.
- **Cross-platform lifecycle safety:** the Windows resilience sidecar ecosystem is gated to Windows. Linux eBPF, Remote Bridge, local AI triage, Adaptive Resource Governor, and macOS Observe now declare their actual platform support explicitly.
- **Distribution boundary:** Windows remains the supported one-click Protect release. macOS remains a source/developer Observe preview until the containing app and system extension receive Apple entitlements, stable bundle/team identities, hardened-runtime signing, privacy review, notarization, upgrade/uninstall handling, and Apple Silicon/VM validation.
- **Verification:** repository pytest 193 passed / 1 platform skip / 0 failed; focused platform contract 8/8; compile gate 230 Python files / 0 failures; Windows discovery 64 declared / 62 available / 0 errors; simulated macOS discovery 4 explicitly compatible capabilities / 0 errors. Native Xcode compilation, entitlement approval, notarization, and physical macOS validation remain external release gates and are not represented as passed.

- **Unified click-to-detail UI:** `gui/dashboard_details.py` supplies reusable `FuturisticHeader`, bounded metric tiles, System Pulse history, ARIA intelligence, expanded guarded-console, module-resource, and SOAR detail surfaces. `gui/pages.py` routes Modules Running, Alerts, Critical, Threat Level, Modules, Live Alerts, SOAR Queue, Console, module-history alerts, ResourceStrip chips, and both bottom module-status rows through the same real-destination reveal. `gui/aria_hud.py` makes the ARIA orb a detail entry point; `gui/system_pulse.py` makes System Pulse clickable and retains at most 90 GUI-owned samples. Self-Test and Eco remain immediate and intentionally skip the reveal.

All effects obey `ui_motion_enabled`, `ANGERONA_REDUCE_MOTION`, and Windows reduced-animation settings. Detail views reuse existing bounded dashboard data, do not start security scans, cap console transcript display at 80,000 characters, and stop their timers with their windows.
- **Fresh security/blue-purple fixes:** external capability loading now executes the exact verified bytes, closing the manifest-check/import TOCTOU gap. Causal-graph receipt links are honest unverified references until checked. Receipt verification validates the underlying signed/hash-chained action record instead of trusting stored labels. IR redaction now covers IPv6, UNC paths, URLs, and hostnames. Secure-store temporary files use exclusive randomized creation. Malformed security booleans fail closed. ARIA webhook URLs are held in the Windows DPAPI secret store rather than plaintext settings.
- **Fresh long-session performance fixes:** provenance nodes/edges are bounded with O(1) duplicate rejection; remediation-ledger catch-up is incremental; attack-feed lookups scan newest blocks first; network connection snapshots are shared/cached; mobile alert digests are bounded; MCP start is idempotent with reliable queue shutdown; FlightCache batches commits (20,000 synthetic puts: 1.494 s to 0.796 s, commits 20,000 to 157 in the focused benchmark).
- **Visionary/enterprise addition:** `enterprise_capability_drift_c5.py` is a read-only AST Capability Drift Auditor. It never imports or executes inspected extensions; it compares source behavior with manifest permissions, reports digest/entrypoint drift and unsafe constructs, and privacy-minimizes paths. Design record: `analysis/loop/visionary_cycle5.md`.
- **Red Team/Shark enterprise upgrade:** `shark/run_manifest.py` adds a fail-closed pre-execution budget, versioned run/step identities, ATT&CK-mapped realized plans, privacy-minimized artifact receipts, a SHA-256 evidence chain, HMAC attestation, bounded atomic I/O, and strict loading. `shark_attack.py` and `red_team.py` refuse invalid runs before starting work. `aar_report.py` and `modules/evolution_engine.py` accept only verified drill ground truth, so altered/unsigned history cannot create an AAR or influence generated YARA. The Red Team console is resizable and screen-aware, scrolls its configuration, wraps the kill-chain, and keeps Launch/Stop in a sticky footer at its 700×520 minimum size.
- **Holographic minimized Angerona Orb:** `gui/holographic_orb.py` adds a frameless, always-on-top, draggable Qt token drawn entirely from vector primitives. Native minimize and main-window close-to-background paths hide the source after remembering exact client geometry, animate its frame into a vertical line and dot, and restore through the reverse transition without cumulative window growth. Clicking the globe expands four unique radial destinations: Core restores the dashboard; Watchdog, Scanner, and Black Box open their existing live resilience status/control widgets in-process. Double-click restores the most recently collapsed window. Placement persists in `settings.json`, multi-monitor bounds are clamped, the timer runs at 20 FPS only while visible, and the central motion gate makes the globe static and transitions immediate for reduced-motion users. Settings > General includes a live enable/disable toggle; disabling restores any collapsed windows first.
- **Packet Sniffer crash containment (live incident fix):** `modules/packet_sniffer.py` no longer imports or runs Scapy/Npcap inside Core. `packet_sniffer_worker.py` performs bounded capture/dissection in a hidden subprocess; native `0xC0000005`, malformed-frame, and driver failures return as degraded worker state with exponential restart backoff while Core, the globe, and the watchdog stay online. The JSONL boundary is capped at 256 records and carries only source, destination, and token kind—captured credential values are never returned or logged. The live diagnostic record showed six watchdog Core restarts with the faulting `Packet Sniffer` thread garbage-collecting inside Scapy; globe paint frames were bystanders, not the fault source.
- **Watchdog anti-flap fix:** `resilience/heartbeat.py` now declares a missing heartbeat PID dead immediately instead of waiting through the suspension window. The Python watchdog gives a still-live, heartbeat-delayed Core 12 seconds and Scanner 8 seconds; the prior 3-second Core threshold produced false suspension decisions during heavy startup, one duplicate singleton launch, and SAFE_MODE even while the original Core PID remained healthy. True process death remains immediate, while live scheduling jitter no longer drives close/reopen loops.
- **Verification:** repository pytest **185 passed / 1 platform skip / 0 failed**; focused fresh UI/security/performance/visionary/drill gate **40/40 PASS**; packet-isolation/watchdog/orb gate **19/19 PASS**; holographic-orb/dashboard UI gate **14/14 PASS**; orb/UI/security gate **21/21 PASS**; enterprise drill-contract gate **9/9 PASS**; `tools/selfcheck.py` **26/26 PASS** (expected stopped/idle/Ollama module outcomes classified by the harness); `run_aria_selftests.py` **13/13 PASS**; compile gate **223 files / 0 failures**; module discovery **63**. Consolidated result: `analysis/loop/cycle5_three_loop_summary.md`.

The repository copy is `analysis/Angerona_Master_Manual_v1.9.4_Cycle6.docx`. This `llms.txt` remains the dense machine/agent contract.

## LATEST (v1.9.4 — Cycle 4 security, proof, performance, and public-release pass)
- **Three-loop result:** visionary research, adversarial review, blue/purple remediation, bug testing, performance profiling, privacy review, and independent final gates completed against the integrated tree.
- **Enterprise extension trust:** `core/capability_manifest.py` validates a detached `<module>.angerona.json` before `exec_module`. The manifest binds the exact source SHA-256, API/entrypoint, permissions, telemetry/MITRE declarations, privacy/egress/retention, performance budgets, publisher, and Ed25519 signature. Trusted keys live in `<data_dir>/trust/module_publishers.json`; unsigned external modules are denied unless the operator explicitly enables hash-pinned development mode with `ANGERONA_ALLOW_UNSIGNED_EXTERNAL_MODULES=1`.
- **Causal incident graph:** `core/causal_incident_graph.py` is a bounded read-side builder, not an EventBus subscriber and not a response authority. It keeps the newest facts independent of input ordering; separates PID generations; represents process/file/network/parent/correlation/response/proof nodes and edges; labels temporal `precedes` separately; and records an evidence basis plus confidence for every relationship.
- **Proof-carrying remediation receipts:** `core/remediation_receipts.py` and `core/remediation_log.py` create privacy-minimal HMAC-authenticated receipts chained to the preceding record. The receipt binds the canonical action-record digest and verification state. An `applied` outcome without a passed postcondition fails receipt validation. Vetted fixes publish only the receipt ID/hash and correlation ID for causal-graph linkage.
- **Enterprise visibility/API:** Settings has an **Enterprise** tab with a live evidence-based readiness report and bounded causal snapshot. Console `enterprise`/`readiness` and MCP `get_enterprise_readiness`/`get_causal_incident_graph` expose the same read-only views. Existing MCP alert, module-health, and incident endpoints now use canonical Angerona fields.
- **Honest remaining gaps:** this is an enterprise foundation, not a fleet product. Mutual-authenticated endpoint enrollment, organization RBAC/audit, signed centrally distributed policy, cross-endpoint search/storage, HA, and a case-management/control plane remain unimplemented and are scored as gaps.
- **Authenticated drill learning:** strict signed-AAR verification is now the default. Unsigned, tampered, verifier-error, and manual-resolution bypass paths fail closed. Candidate installation cannot certify its creating run; a distinct later run needs an exact Purple Guard detector echo, and a future miss reopens the finding.
- **Honest remediation score:** an Active Response event with `mitigated=False` is not remediation. Automatic response defaults to CRITICAL. The simulation temporarily lowers that floor only inside an explicit scope and accepts only recognized `_redteam_`/`_shark_` artifacts or tagged `ANGERONA_REDTEAM_<token>` process evidence.
- **Cloud alert privacy:** `AnalysisWorker` defaults to local-only and accepts only literal `allow_cloud=True`. Live-alert Analyze has a separate default-off `alert_analysis_cloud_fallback` setting; general ARIA consent cannot silently authorize it. The provider receives a separate recursively redacted prompt with sensitive-key, token/JWT, path, address, string, text, depth, node, container, and total-prompt bounds.
- **Qt responsiveness:** Top Talkers moves connection/process/interface/PTR collection and AI analysis to single-flight Qt thread-pool workers and ignores late results after close. Upgrade Console loads and checks models asynchronously. Resolve Center and alert history use immediate-only storage reads with EventBus fallback. Black Box skips hidden telemetry repaints and reuses unchanged marker series.
- **Lifecycle and watchdog safety:** module restart uses monotonic, join-aware generations. SPEC workers, AI recovery pingers, IPC acceptors/clients, and ARP capture helpers retire with their owning generation instead of overlapping a restart. The Watchdog window exposes **Restart Angerona Core** through a target-specific authenticated command; it clears SAFE_MODE, verifies an adopted Core's executable/command identity, terminates it, and relaunches it. If safe termination fails, no duplicate is spawned. Automatic dead/suspended recovery remains active. Eco first-cycle sequencing and Angerona-only llama3 unload behavior remain intact.
- **Measured performance:** ATT&CK tracker saturated retention 14.17× faster; Compliance Mapper retention 3.90× faster; unchanged 2,000-file HEAL poll 816× faster; status reporting 19% less work. Network socket/PID knowledge, Forensics capture memory, and HEAL filename state are pruned and bounded. All changes preserve bounded retention and detection semantics.
- **D-drive hygiene:** launcher diagnostics now use `<install-folder>\runtime-data\diagnostics`; scanner reports, databases, drill artifacts, temporary files, logs, models, and watchdog state remain within the canonical runtime root. The source and release installers keep their existing one-click dependency paths.
- **Public-release state:** future repository commits use `Ag3nt47@users.noreply.github.com`. Existing Git author metadata is not rewritten by this pass. Release ZIP hashes, SBOMs, and provenance do not replace publisher authentication; Authenticode/MSIX signing remains an external release decision.
- **Innovation research (not shipped):** NTFS Journal Ransomware Pulse, NTLM Exit Radar, Stack-to-Image Provenance Fuse, Local Model Airlock, QUIC Sightline, and Split-Token Angerona are buildable proposals in `analysis/loop/innovation_ideas.md`.
- **Final gates:** compile scan PASS; repository pytest **133 passed / 1 platform skip / 0 failed**; `tools/selfcheck.py` **26/26 PASS**; `run_aria_selftests.py` **13/13 PASS**; module discovery **63 with 0 errors**; focused Cycle 4 regression gate **49/49 PASS**; offscreen Settings/Enterprise smoke test PASS. A synthetic 100,000-event causal-graph run completed in **2.958 s** (**29.58 μs/input event**), retained the configured 1,000-event window, respected the 2,500-node cap, and added about **3.81 MiB RSS**. No Python, Qt, or native crash was observed during the verification run.

- **Proof-carrying Purple remediation:** a missed drill step remains VULNERABLE after a candidate is installed. SIEM defaults to verified TLS. YARA uses in-process YARA-X rather than a CWD/PATH executable.

Posture sparkline and trend reads measured 4.75× and 14.92× faster, and forced contention returns cached HUD data in 0.031 ms instead of waiting on SQLite. Immediate-only committed dashboard reads, idempotent subscriptions, bounded caches, and race-free sequential Eco wake prevent the confirmed freeze paths without relaxing detection.

Model download is explicit or installer-driven—never triggered merely by constructing the GUI.

Mutable data defaults to protected `D:\AngeronaData` on a fixed D: volume and falls back to protected `%ProgramData%\Angerona` only when D: is unavailable. The offline speech model, all dynamic modules, ARIA docs/playbooks, and the complete release dependency lock are bundled. The source `Install-Angerona.bat` is contributor mode: it rejects untrusted pre-existing venvs and non-Authenticode Python/Ollama executables. Releases emit SHA-256, SBOM, and provenance attestations; they are not yet Authenticode signed, so Windows may show Unknown Publisher.

## LATEST (v1.8.0 — Cycle 2 three-loop convergence)
- **Security/remediation:** path-rich process suppression requires exact canonical path; basename trust is pathless-only and cannot skip memory scanning. AAR correlation requires exact path or PID plus opaque drill token, bounded windows, single-use evidence, and trigger-timestamp remediation binding. Simulated gaps resolve deterministically per run.
- **Drill lifecycle:** Red Team and Shark Stop & Clean use interruptible cancellation, a bounded 250 ms join, final scoped cleanup, and overlap refusal. Cancelled Shark runs do not emit completion/AAR callbacks.
- **Shutdown:** emergency recovery accepts only the exact suite interpreter or the first canonical Python entry point beneath the repo boundary. It does not infer ownership from a later argument, sibling prefix, or process name, and it contains no image-wide Python/Ollama kill.
- **ARIA safety:** disabled state fails closed. WRITE previews bind the exact callback version, kind, immutable recursive arguments, preview, expiry, and digest. Tokens are full 128-bit UUID4 hex, collision-safe, single-use, and TTL-pruned. `research` is local-only READ; browser opening is a separate confirmed WRITE/egress action and defaults off.
- **Storage/performance:** all runtime/temp/report/scanner paths remain under `runtime-data` on D:. SQLite is hard-bounded and severity-aware. SOAR parse and card-render caches are constant-size. After the valid 21:39:50 5.4-second storage-lock stall, dashboard/live-alert refreshes use a committed revision and immediate-only reads; busy refreshes preserve the last complete view and retry without blocking Qt.
- **Innovation boundary:** `core/action_policy.py` is a bounded digest-only Response Safety Kernel **shadow experiment**. No confirmation, callback, SOAR, Resolve Center, drill, shutdown, trust, or storage branch consumes its ALLOW/DENY result. Do not describe it as shipped authorization.

## LATEST (v1.7.8 — staged scanner wake-up, D-drive storage, and clean AI shutdown)
- **True one-cycle Eco wake-up:** `BaseModule` now publishes a first-cycle completion barrier. Turning Eco Mode off waits until each heavy scanner finishes its initial baseline/scan before waking the next; stale health no longer lets every scanner start within seconds. Long cycles have bounded safety timeouts and are left alive rather than killed.
- **Real-time telemetry never sleeps:** ETW Core Listener, Sysmon Event Bridge, AMSI Bridge, AV Telemetry Bridge, and Network Protocol Deep Decoder stay live in Eco Mode. This prevents deliberate Eco pauses from looking like ETW/Security-channel blinding to DRILL/TECT.
- **GUI alert-storm fix:** Live Alerts uses lightweight clickable table items instead of 360 per-row button widgets. Resolve Center queries a bounded newest-first HIGH/CRITICAL slice, refreshes only when HIGH+ state changes, displays 75 actionable rows, and no longer re-verifies a full 24-hour INFO-heavy ledger on the GUI thread.
- **Hot policy caches:** process trust and drill-resolution policy are snapshotted once per batch in threat posture, Resolve Center, memory scanning, SOAR, posture evaluation, and AAR generation. Per-event `Config.load()`/JSON reads are eliminated while mtime invalidation preserves live updates.
- **Install-drive runtime root:** `core/data_paths.py` establishes `<install-folder>\runtime-data` before crash logging or module import. `start-angerona.bat`, `run.bat`, guarded/watchdog launch, Black Box, forensics, flight recorder, scanner reports, and inherited temp work use that drive. Frozen builds prefer protected `D:\AngeronaData` on a fixed D: volume, collision-safely auto-migrate legacy per-user C: spill, and use protected `%PROGRAMDATA%\Angerona` only as the no-D: fallback.
- **Bounded database footprint:** the fresh D: flight recorder uses incremental auto-vacuum, a 16 MiB WAL journal limit, periodic passive checkpoints, and the existing 40,000-row retention cap, so deleting old rows also releases disk pages.
- **Bounded drill/report footprint:** default drill and continuous-verification markers use `<runtime-data>/drill-sandbox`, which FIM and YARA monitor directly. AAR archives keep 40 runs/30 days (`ANGERONA_AAR_HISTORY_RUNS` / `ANGERONA_AAR_HISTORY_DAYS` override). The UI watchdog trims its active log and single archive to 4 MiB each, including oversized legacy `.1` files at next launch.
- **llama3 shutdown:** normal application shutdown queries Ollama's running-model list and immediately unloads resident Angerona llama3 variants with `keep_alive: 0`. `kill-all-angerona.bat` uses model-specific `ollama stop` and never image-kills every Ollama runner.
- **Focused verification:** touched files compile; deterministic gates confirm sequential first-cycle ordering, D:-resident default data, and selective llama3 unload behavior.

Removed watch roots are not misreported as mass file deletions.

The AAR reports run-scoped closures without claiming detection coverage that did not occur.

## LATEST (v1.7.6 — Legendary Upgrades: Cortex + 6 next-gen MVP engines)
Seven **additive, read-only, self-tested** `core/` engines that turn Angerona's ~61 independent detectors into a correlating/learning/explaining/self-improving system. Each ships as a core engine + `self_test()` and is **NOT wired into app startup** (zero behavior/detection risk until deliberately enabled). Vision + build notes: `analysis/loop/visionary/legendary_upgrades.md`.
- **`core/cortex.py` (Angerona Cortex) ★ flagship** — a live entity graph (process/file/user/IP…) where every event adds a decay-weighted signal and a per-entity **malice score** rises as independent weak signals converge on the SAME entity, with an explainable "why" (which signals/modules/tactics). Streamlines + unifies `attack_tracker` + `provenance_graph` + `incident_timeline` + `evidence_lattice` + SOAR. `init_cortex()/get_cortex()`, `feed(event)`, `attach(bus)`, `snapshot()`, `top_entity_score()`. self_test: fused proc:42 **65.5** > lone HIGH 16.8 > lone MEDIUM 8.4 (the 1+1=3).
- **`core/angerona_score.py`** — collapses threat level + posture + coverage% + Cortex top-entity + unresolved counts into ONE explainable 0–100 safety score (SECURE→CRITICAL) + a single ranked next-best-action. self_test: quiet→88/SECURE, attack→0/CRITICAL→"Contain…".
- **`core/sigma_engine.py`** — a Sigma-subset matcher (named selections; `contains/startswith/endswith/re` modifiers; list-OR; `condition` incl. `and not filter`, `all/1 of them`) → import the public Sigma rule library for standards-native detection. `SigmaSet`, `match(rule,event)`, `event_fields()`.
- **`core/ocsf_export.py`** — `to_finding(event)` maps events → OCSF **Detection Finding** (class_uid 2004) with severity, ATT&CK technique, observables → real SIEM/XDR interop via the existing forwarder.
- **`core/d3fend_map.py`** — ATT&CK technique → MITRE **D3FEND** countermeasure + whether Angerona implements it (a defensive scorecard for the heatmap). `lookup(tid)`, `summary()` (19 techniques, 88% implemented).
- **`core/purple_loop.py`** — self-hardening coverage loop: compares red-team-simulated vs actually-detected (`attack_coverage`) to find gaps and drafts **review-gated** candidate Sigma rules (proposals only; nothing installed/executed). `find_gaps()`, `propose_detection()`, `run()`.
- **`core/copilot.py`** — Angerona Copilot: local, read-only natural-language query over the Cortex graph + event feed ("what's the biggest threat?", "why is it critical?", "what did proc:42 touch?", "coverage?"), deterministic offline intent parser + optional local-Ollama. `classify()`, `answer()`.
- All seven `self_test()` PASS in the combined tree (copilot verified via isolated harness — the sandbox mount truncates its ~8 KB read; host file is valid). Recommended production order: wire Cortex → Score on header → Sigma module → Copilot pane → OCSF/D3FEND/purple-loop panels.

## LATEST (v1.8.0 — ARIA: JARVIS-style assistant, all local, gated, additive)
A new ARIA layer — a local, defensive-only "JARVIS" for Angerona. Eleven new modules, each **off by default**, wired into nothing at import, stdlib-first, with a `self_test()`. Run all at once with `python run_aria_selftests.py` (repo root). Non-negotiables preserved: every action gated (confirm-then-execute), defensive-only, local-first, mic/voice/connectors off by default.
- **Local core** (`src/angerona/core/`):
  - **ARIA Overdrive** (`perf_governor.py`) — adaptive performance governor for the **cosmetic/UI path only**. Samples the suite's own vitals, computes a load band (NOMINAL→ELEVATED→HIGH→CRITICAL) with rise/fall hysteresis, and publishes a read-only `TuningProfile(refresh_ms, panel_cap, scan_cap, info_drop_occupancy, coalesce_ms)` panels can read instead of hardcoded constants. NOMINAL == today's shipped values. Threat-aware priority inversion: a threat spike sheds UI first to protect detection. HARD INVARIANT: only ever relaxes cosmetic work — never throttles detection/correlation/response. `get_governor()`/`init_governor()`, `config.perf_governor_enabled` default off.
  - **ARIA assistant** (`assistant.py`) — agentic engine: conversation memory + a READ/WRITE tool registry. Reads run live; **writes are confirm-then-execute** with immutable callback/version/argument/preview binding, a five-minute TTL, full 128-bit collision-safe single-use tokens, and expiry pruning. Proactive triggers speak, never act. Ships no offensive tools. `get_assistant()`/`init_assistant()`.
  - **Runbook RAG** (`runbook_rag.py`) — pure-Python BM25 over your markdown playbooks; `answer()` cites your own procedures (file › heading). No model, no network. `get_rag()`/`init_rag(roots)`.
  - **Posture history** (`posture_history.py`) — append-only Angerona-Score trend (SQLite, held connection like `storage.py`); series/trend/downsample/sparkline for the HUD. `get_history()`/`init_history(db_path)`.
  - **ARIA routines** (`aria_routines.py`) — nightly briefing / weekly red-team drill / daily coverage check; pure ctx→text composers with suggested crons; scheduling delegated. `get_routines()`.
  - **ARIA dispatch** (`aria_dispatch.py`) — exposes the 6-agent improvement loop + subagents (red-team/verifier/threat-research) as **gated WRITE tools** on the assistant via `register_dispatch_tools()`. Runs nothing itself; wraps an injected `runner(agent, task)`.
- **HUD** (`src/angerona/gui/aria_hud.py`) — pulsing orb tied to the Angerona Score (colour + pulse by band), live status line, posture sparkline, chat box to the assistant. Pure `orb_state()` core is Qt-free + self-tested; `AriaHud(QWidget)` import-guarded.
- **Connectors** (`src/angerona/connectors/`, all opt-in, degraded-safe):
  - **voice.py** — local TTS (pyttsx3/SAPI) + STT (vosk/faster-whisper) + "hey aria" wake word; mic off by default; I/O only, commands go to the gated assistant. ElevenLabs only on explicit cloud opt-in.
  - **channel_push.py** — the one outbound connector: pushes briefings/criticals to Slack/Teams/ntfy/webhook; off by default, min-level filter, secret redaction on every message.
  - **inbox_triage.py** — local, explainable phishing heuristics (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, Reply-To mismatch, lookalike domain, exe/macro attachments, lure terms, link masking) → score/verdict/reasons; read-only IMAP fetch opt-in; lifts CVE advisories into the feed.
  - **research.py** — research-on-command: classifies an indicator (hash/ip/domain/url/CVE) and builds vetted, allow-listed read-only lookup URLs (VirusTotal/NVD/CISA KEV/AbuseIPDB/URLhaus). The registered `research` READ is local-only and performs no opener/fetch call.
  - **research_fetchers.py** — the egress bridge. `open_research_sources` is a separate WRITE action whose preview names destinations and redacts the indicator; browser opening occurs only after confirmation and defaults off. The optional headless fetcher remains GET-only, allow-list restricted, and refuses egress unless explicitly enabled.
- Verified: `run_aria_selftests.py` executed green — **13/13 PASS**. Re-run any time with `python run_aria_selftests.py` from the repo root.

Because the history deque is never consumed, the old rule permanently discarded INFO telemetry after 85% capacity, before subscribers/storage saw it. The bounded deque now rolls off old history without dropping delivery.

The harness now performs deterministic Qt/module cleanup and uses a direct post-cleanup exit to avoid a PySide6 interpreter-finalization fault on Windows.

When narration outruns local Ollama, old coaching requests are coalesced toward the newest stage; raw drill telemetry is still emitted without loss. This replaces unbounded thread-per-line spawning.
- **Burst-aware Live Alerts** (`gui/pages.py`) — full-window gap rebuilds are limited to once per five seconds during sustained telemetry floods, preventing repeated construction/destruction of hundreds of Qt widgets. HIGH/CRITICAL detection and SOAR processing remain live on the EventBus.
- **Non-blocking flow metrics** (`gui/main_window.py`) — the optional canvas JSON snapshot is written by a coalesced background writer instead of performing filesystem work on the Qt thread.
- **Lightweight UI watchdog** (`core/uiwatchdog.py`) — stall dumps are rate-limited to once per 60 seconds, rotate at 4 MB, and capture the actionable MainThread stack plus a compact live-thread list instead of dumping every module stack while holding the GIL.
- **Cached acknowledgement path** (`core/alert_ack.py`) — repository-root discovery is cached, removing repeated filesystem traversal from dashboard threat-level refreshes.
- Verification: modified files pass `py_compile`; focused invariants confirm the watchdog limits, root cache, and bounded queue. A true multi-hour GUI soak still requires running the Windows desktop application.

## LATEST (v1.5.5 — Resolve Center, red-team console cleanup, Clean & Close)
- **Legacy Live Offense Monitor removed from the Red Team sim** (`gui/main_window.py` `_run_simulation`): the new console already shows live events, so `shark_monitor` is no longer popped up — narration AND analogy coaching (`_shark_narration` + `_fi_coaching`) now flow into the console (`red_team_console.py` connects both).
